using System;
using System.Threading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public unsafe class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        // We create a minimal subclass to expose ProcessPrimaryStream for testing if needed
        // but here we test the original method directly.

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsErrorAndThrows_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerForTest(loggerMock.Object, clusterProviderMock.Object);

            // Setup clusterProvider to simulate CannotStreamAOF = true
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.replicationManager).Returns(replicationManager);
            replicationManager.CannotStreamAOF = true;

            // Setup clusterManager.CurrentConfig to a valid replica node role
            var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);
            clusterManagerMock.SetupGet(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(new ClusterConfig { LocalNodeRole = NodeRole.REPLICA, LocalNodeId = "node1" });

            // Setup serverOptions with default values
            var serverOptions = new ServerOptions
            {
                ReplicationOffsetMaxLag = 1,
                FastAofTruncate = false,
                EnableFastCommit = false
            };
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.serverOptions).Returns(serverOptions);

            // Setup storeWrapper with minimal stub
            var storeWrapper = new StoreWrapperStub();
            clusterProviderMock.SetupGet(c => c.storeWrapper).Returns(storeWrapper);

            // Setup logger in replicationManager
            replicationManager.SetLogger(loggerMock.Object);

            // Prepare dummy record pointer
            byte[] dummyRecord = new byte[1];
            fixed (byte* pRecord = dummyRecord)
            {
                // Act & Assert
                var ex = Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() =>
                    replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(pRecord, dummyRecord.Length, 0, 0, 0));

                Assert.Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF", ex.Message);

                // Verify LogError was called with the expected message
                loggerMock.Verify(
                    x => x.Log(
                        LogLevel.Error,
                        It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                        It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF")),
                        null,
                        It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                    Times.Once);
            }
        }

        // Minimal stubs and mocks for dependencies
        private class ReplicationManagerForTest : ReplicationManager
        {
            public bool CannotStreamAOF { get; set; }
            private ILogger _logger;
            public ReplicationManagerForTest(ILogger logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            }

            public void SetLogger(ILogger logger) => _logger = logger;

            protected override ILogger logger => _logger;

            // Expose clusterProvider for test setup
            public new IClusterProvider clusterProvider { get; set; }
        }

        private interface IClusterProvider
        {
            IReplicationManager replicationManager { get; }
            IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
            ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
            StoreWrapper storeWrapper { get; }
        }

        private interface IReplicationManager
        {
            bool CannotStreamAOF { get; }
        }

        private interface IClusterManager
        {
            ClusterConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
        }

        private class ClusterConfig
        {
            public NodeRole LocalNodeRole { get; set; }
            public string LocalNodeId { get; set; }
        }

        private enum NodeRole
        {
            REPLICA,
            PRIMARY
        }

        private class ServerOptions
        {
            public int ReplicationOffsetMaxLag { get; set; }
            public bool FastAofTruncate { get; set; }
            public bool EnableFastCommit { get; set; }
        }

        private class StoreWrapperStub : StoreWrapper
        {
            public override AppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile => new AppendOnlyFileStub();
            public override Database DefaultDatabase => null;
        }

        private class AppendOnlyFileStub : AppendOnlyFile
        {
            public override long TailAddress => 0;
            public override void SafeInitialize(long a, long b) { }
            public override object UnsafeEnqueueRaw(Span<byte> span, bool noCommit) => null;
        }

        private abstract class StoreWrapper
        {
            public abstract AppendOnlyFile appendOnlyFile { get; }
            public abstract Database DefaultDatabase { get; }
        }

        private abstract class AppendOnlyFile
        {
            public abstract long TailAddress { get; }
            public abstract void SafeInitialize(long a, long b);
            public abstract object UnsafeEnqueueRaw(Span<byte> span, bool noCommit);
        }

        private abstract class Database
        {
            public abstract VectorManager VectorManager { get; }
        }

        private abstract class VectorManager
        {
            public abstract void WaitForVectorOperationsToComplete();
        }
    }
}
